crates/shapes/src/constraints.rs: 1
`1320-1344`: **🚀 Performance & Scalability** | **🔵 Trivial** | **⚡ Quick win** **Call `planned` once per constraint on the per-focus-node path.** In `walk_shape`, every node-level constraint calls `plan.planned(constraint, lowered)` once for the `PropertyReference` check. Each constraint that is not a property reference then calls `plan.planned(...)` a second time at Line 1349. `eval_property_shape` repeats this pattern at Line 1850 and Line 1886. This loop runs for each focus node and each value-node recursion. The duplicate call repeats slot lookups and, for `Reference`/`PropertyReference`, the catalog hash lookup in `indexed`. The bounded-allocation claims depend on this path staying lean. Bind the result once and dispatch on it.
♻️ Proposed refactor (node-level loop; apply the same pattern in `eval_property_shape`) ```diff - if let PlannedConstraint::PropertyReference { - definition, - edge, - deactivated_when, - } = plan.planned(constraint, lowered)? - { + let planned = plan.planned(constraint, lowered)?; + if let PlannedConstraint::PropertyReference { + definition, + edge, + deactivated_when, + } = planned + { ... continue; } ... if eval_constraint( context, focus, &node_value_nodes, - plan.planned(constraint, lowered)?, + planned, ```
Also applies to: 1846-1873

Preserve ownership so the non-property-reference result remains available for evaluation. ```

🧹 Nitpick comments: 1
crates/shapes/tests/product_model_census.rs: 1
`1090-1106`: **📐 Maintainability & Code Quality** | **🔵 Trivial** | **⚡ Quick win** **Add the omitted lowering helpers to the census inventory.** `CLASS_ANALYSIS_SITES` is the complete source for the scraped rows and stage-ID preimage. It omits `lower_constraints`, `lower_expressions`, and `lower_shape_list`. A change in any of these helpers can alter carried class reachability without changing a listed row, so the census stage ID can remain unchanged. This is a test-only coverage gap and does not show that the current production implementation is incorrect.
Suggested fix ```diff -const CLASS_ANALYSIS_SITES: [(&str, &str, &str); 15] = [ +const CLASS_ANALYSIS_SITES: [(&str, &str, &str); 18] = [ ... ("", "fn", "lower_constraint"), + ("", "fn", "lower_constraints"), ("", "fn", "lower_reference"), ("", "fn", "lower_expression"), + ("", "fn", "lower_expressions"), + ("", "fn", "lower_shape_list"), ]; ```
